title: plan-status-check report
description: L1 reporter output schema for `plan-status-check` (docs/FABLE_AGENT_SUBAGENT_PLAN.md task F4). Mirrors the Output section of claude-agents/plan-status-check.md. Constrains envelope.result via claude -p --json-schema; it does not describe the F3 report wrapper.

originRef.description: The exact origin ref read, e.g. origin/main:docs/PLAN.md, so the report is falsifiable.

noDisagreementsFound.description: True only when every Status row was checked and none disagreed.

subject.description: What the finding is about: repo, PR, worktree path, file:line, workstream.

detail.description: One line, stating the evidence (the command or API read) the finding rests on.

findings.description: Uniform finding list (plan F4 / ladder findings[]): one entry per flagged item, drawn from the tables in this same object. Empty array = nothing flagged, which is only a clean result if couldNotCheck is also empty.

reason.description: Why it could not be checked (gh error, rate limit, unreadable file, no network).

couldNotCheck.description: Everything this run could not reach. An unqueried item is listed here, never reported as clean.
